title: Survey Donkey
tagline: A platform to launch fully-decentralized and incentivized surveys
description: Empowering decentralized research - Our platform allows anyone to securely create surveys, distribute them to targeted audiences directly to their wallet addresses, and reward participation with crypto - all on the blockchain. Democratizing data collection without central authorities. Users own their responses, surveys are uncensorable, and results are transparently verifiable. The application allows a survey creator to create a new survey on the Smart Contract, collect responses from participants by messaging them using XMTP notifications, and reward them for their response. Survey questions and responses are stored on IPFS.
how_its_made: The survey application is built with a NextJS frontend. Survey questions submitted by a creator are stored on IPFS. A survey responder, responding to a survey has their formed rendered from IPFS. Both questions and response hashes are stored on the Smart Contract to ensure gas optimization. Surveys are delivered to participants through XMTP notifications.
